title: The Dust World
summary: Stranded on the far side of the ring, under a burning sun. Find water, then a way home.

platform.name: Ring Platform
platform.description: You stumble out of the ring onto a stone platform. Behind you, the ring falls silent. Sand stretches in every direction under two white suns. A weathered pedestal stands before the ring. Green palms wave to the east; to the south, dunes roll toward the horizon.

descriptionWhen.text: The pedestal glows a steady blue.
The ring is open again, its surface rippling. Home is one step through the ring.

east.description: A path of flat stones toward the palms.

south.lockedMessage: Three steps into the dunes, the heat drives you back. You won't cross them without water.

ring.description: The ring that brought you here. It only goes home if someone dials home.
ring.lockedMessage: You walk through the inert stone ring and out the other side, still on the platform.

oasis.name: Oasis
oasis.description: A ring of palms around an old stone well. The shade is a blessing.

dunes.name: Sea of Dunes
dunes.description: Waves of red sand as far as you can see. Half-buried bones of some huge creature lie nearby. A glint of metal catches your eye in the sand. Far to the south, a pyramid of black stone.

north.description: Your own footprints, leading back to the ring.

south.description: The black pyramid. Its entrance is a dark triangle.

temple.name: Temple of the Two Suns
temple.description: A cool hall inside the pyramid. Light falls through a shaft onto a stone altar with a round hollow in its top. The far wall is covered in carvings.

descriptionWhen.text: The altar's lid has slid aside.

kit.name: Field Kit
kit.description: Your standard-issue field kit, still zipped shut. Something metal rattles inside. Use it to unpack it.

full_flask.name: Full Flask
full_flask.description: A metal flask full of cool well water. Enough to cross the dunes.

pedestal.name: Dialing Pedestal
pedestal.description: A stone pedestal ringed with symbols, like the console back home, but older. A crystal socket in its side is empty.
pedestal.fixedMessage: It is carved from the platform itself.

ring.name: Stone Ring
ring.description: The twin of the ring under the mountain, worn by sandstorms.

well.name: Stone Well
well.description: You can hear water far below, much deeper than your arm can reach.
well.fixedMessage: It's a well. It stays where it is.

rope.name: Frayed Rope
rope.description: A long rope, frayed but strong. Someone used it to draw water.

disc.name: Bronze Disc
disc.description: A heavy bronze disc engraved with two suns. It is exactly the size of your palm.

bones.name: Giant Bones
bones.description: The ribs alone are taller than you. Whatever it was, it didn't make it across the dunes either.
bones.fixedMessage: Even one rib is far too heavy.

altar.name: Stone Altar
altar.description: A block of black stone. In its top, a round hollow engraved with two suns.
altar.fixedMessage: It is part of the temple.

carving.name: Wall Carvings
carving.description: Rows of symbols. One group is set apart and framed with a picture of a mountain: an address. Home, maybe?
carving.fixedMessage: They are carved into the wall.

crystal.name: Sun Crystal
crystal.description: A golden crystal that pulses with warm light. It would fit a socket.

rules.message: You empty the field kit: rations, a map of the wrong planet, and an empty flask. You keep the flask.
You tie the flask to the rope and lower it into the dark. It comes back up full of cold water.
The water is far below. Your arm doesn't come close.
You lower the rope into the well. It comes back up wet. You need something to hold the water.
You take a careful sip. Better keep the rest for the dunes.
The disc clicks into the hollow. Sunlight from the shaft hits it, and the altar's lid grinds aside, revealing a glowing crystal.
You trace the framed symbols with your finger until you know them by heart.
The crystal slides into the socket. The pedestal hums and its symbols light up.
You press the symbols from the temple wall, one by one. The ring spins, locks, and erupts into a shimmering pool of light.
The symbols are dead. The empty crystal socket says it all.
The pedestal is powered, but which symbols lead home? Somebody here must have written it down.
